comments.author: Lena Fischer

summary: Chargeback webhook receiver
description:
Receive and verify chargeback webhooks from the provider, then open a dispute record.
Owner: Diego Santos.
BLOCKED: the provider has not published the webhook signature-verification spec for v3, so we cannot verify authenticity and will not accept unverified webhooks.

comments.author: Diego Santos
comments.body: Receiver and dispute records are done behind a feature flag. The signature verification is stubbed out.

comments.body: Their v2 signing doc does not apply to v3 - the header name and the canonicalisation both changed. Asked for the v3 spec, no reply yet.

comments.author: Julian Vega
comments.body: Do not ship this without verification. An unauthenticated webhook that opens dispute records is an abuse vector, flag or no flag.

comments.author: Diego Santos
comments.body: Agreed, staying blocked rather than shipping it unverified.

comments.author: Tomas Ferreira
